schema:name: Merry Edwards 2019 Russian River Valley and Sonoma County Legacy Pinot Noir
schema:creator: Edwards, Merry
schema:description: Merry Edwards Russian River Valley Legacy Pinot Noir celebrated Merry Edwards' retirement from her legendary career as a winemaker that spanned five decades. A collaboration between Merry Edwards and winemaker Heidi von der Mehden, it was a blend of Russian River Valley and Sonoma County pinot noir. Von der Mehden, an acclaimed winemaker, succeeded Merry Edwards as winemaker at Merry Edwards Wines after Edwards' retirement.
